settings.title: A Solution for a Better CBD
settings.text:
NextEvo CBD is better because our SmartSorb™ technology optimizes CBD for better bioavailability, so your body can absorb more of it. CBD is oil-soluble, which means it’s hard for the human body to absorb.

While other CBD products can pass right through your system with little absorption, we’ve created a technology that allows your body to soak up the CBD goodness.

settings.subtitle: CEO & President
settings.title: John McDonagh
settings.text: John is a seasoned consumer packaged goods industry veteran with 25 years of experience in the sector.

John has served as a marketing and sales leader for Johnson & Johnson as well as McNeil Consumer & Specialty Pharmaceuticals, the makers of Tylenol, and Lifescan on the OneTouch Glucose Monitor brand, and has a deep-seated understanding of creating value and changing the perspective of consumers from these roles. John received both his B.S. in Accountancy and studied for his M.B.A. at Villanova University.

settings.subtitle: VP of R&D
settings.title: Gerry McNally, Ph.D.
settings.text: Gerry McNally is a seasoned consumer healthcare R&D executive who has a track record of leading the conception, development, and commercialization of new products in dynamic market-driven environments.

Gerry McNally is a distinguished R&D executive in consumer healthcare with over 25 years of success in driving innovation, who is often referenced in Forbes, Cannibis Tech Today, and other Scientific publications for his expertise. With a rich background in pharmaceuticals and a passion for patient-centered product development, Gerry has led the creation and market introduction of breakthrough products, including taste-masking technologies and novel drug delivery systems. At McNeil Consumer Healthcare and Johnson & Johnson, his leadership saw the successful launch of notable products like Imodium® Multi-Symptom Relief and Tylenol® Rapid Release Gels. Holding a Ph.D. in Chemistry and over 30 patents, Gerry’s extensive experience and contributions have significantly impacted the industry.

settings.subtitle: Chief Medical Officer
settings.title: David Chernoff, MD
settings.text: David is a molecular diagnostics and biopharmaceutical industry veteran with over 25 years of global experience.

David is a molecular diagnostics and biopharmaceutical industry veteran with over 25 years of global experience. As Chief Medical Officer for multiple companies including Adamas, Aquinox, Crescendo Bioscience, Schiff Nutrition, Olly, and SetPoint Medical, David has played pivotal roles in moving early-stage R&D programs successfully through clinical development and product commercialization and evaluating a broad range of in-licensing opportunities. He has a keen interest in anti-inflammatory science. David is a graduate of Yale University as well as the New York University Grossman School of Medicine.
